articles.title: CLARITY Act failure could send crypto valuations lower: Bernstein
articles.snippet: Bernstein said Congress’ failure to pass the CLARITY Act’s could trigger another leg down for crypto valuations and accelerate policy support from US regulators.

articles.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
articles.snippet: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Invokes Bitcoin Creator Satoshi Nakamoto in Plea for Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Scott Bessent urged the Senate to immediately vote on the crypto market structure bill, accusing Democrats of delaying the legislation for political reasons.
